purpose: Actual statistical anomaly repair and Chinese first-question manuscript. Preserve all historical files. No change to V3 rank4 Huber, projection, conditional saturation or bilinear interpolation.
finite_search: Only two thresholds of ONE new score. No further threshold or algorithm search after confirmation.
adaptive_score: Time and wavelength leave-center linear prediction residuals on actual coordinates; noise scales from median absolute residuals at offsets +/-2,+/-3,+/-4, floors25; local rank4 residual center and MAD9x9 floor50. zt,zw,zl. S=sqrt(zt*(0.5*zw/(1+persistence)+0.5*zl))*consistency; persistence counts same-sign spectral prominence in four neighbor frames; consistency=1/(1+abs(time_reference-wave_reference)/(max(50,0.2*abs(time_reference))+st+sw)). This is a dimensionless task-specific score, not a calibrated fault probability.
local_scope: Scores at boundary4 and top-code neighbors radius1 diagnostic only. 8-connected candidate components kept for automatic point repair if temporal span<=3 and spectral span<=7; broader frame/channel changes remain diagnostic, not automatically deleted.
panels: 32x128, chronological gaps after V2 slots1 (development) and2 (confirmation), centered in gap; columns64,1050,1740. Disjoint in raw coordinates from V2, V3, V3.1 LOCAL experiment panels. All ten heats historically studied: new-region/mask confirmation, not external validation.
injections: Reuse unmodified V3.1 inject: spike/drop, strengths0.3/0.7, density0.005, true changed cells only, no detector-based reference exclusion, cap64000 avoids top-code confounding. All four strategies identical paired corruptions.
solver: Unmodified V3 model3.solve rank4 eta.003 max300 tolerance1e-4 for all end-to-end strategies; V3 projection preserves unmasked observations and local nonnegative support; bilinear continuous function. Final full native fits use unchanged stable_completion 600/1200 wall360, fallback flag retained.
selection_loss: Per case: MSE_all_after/MSE_all_before +0.5*MSE_unpolluted/MSE_all_before +0.1*(1-F1)+0.25*mean_relative_peak_height_error+0.25*mean_relative_integral_error+introduced_unsupported_peaks/max(truth_count,1). Average within heat with equal band/kind/strength/seed weight, then heat macro. Select minimum on development, tie within0.01 choose lower unpolluted MSE. No absolute recall/improvement gate or blanket P0 fallback. Confirmation reports fixed choice, no retuning.
native_review: Four V3.1 reviewed isolated points are accepted local-continuity statistical repairs independently of global sensitivity. Union with chosen automatic mask; keep V31 persistent-line veto at6C02108 row608 col1211. Never hardware-fault labels. Additional selected raw candidates retain score, span, persistence and repair evidence. No minimum target repair count.
reference_metrics: Absolute detection P/R/F1, pollution RMSE, all/unpolluted RMSE, whole-spectrum integral/peak metrics, introduced unsupported peaks. Raw reference is noisy. Before/after shape metrics use full spectrum. Report per heat and band; repetitions are not independent heats.
controls: Uninjected real panels and their fastest integral-change frames, prominent original lines; fixed persistent-line counterexample. No new frame/column removal.
confirmation_policy: Physical integrities exact unmasked preservation, nonnegative formal grid, recorded top codes retained. If choice has mixed accuracy, report benefit/cost and apply evidence-based point mask plus audited local repairs; never relabel failed metrics or tune confirmation.
history: Audit historical protocols separately; only unified new protocol is used for comparative superiority claims. V31 historical diagnostics used to explain failure, not for new tuning/test claims.
